title: Responsive layout refinement and accessibility focus states
description: Refine the dashboard layout across desktop (1366x768, 1920x1080) and smaller screens, ensuring visible keyboard focus outlines, ARIA labels on all interactive buttons, and high-contrast color compliance (PRD 6.9).
acceptanceCriteria: Grid stacks cards cleanly on mobile/narrow viewports without clipping camera feeds or buttons
All interactive elements have visible high-contrast focus rings for keyboard navigation
Buttons and inputs include proper aria-label attributes
Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards and avoids relying on color alone for alert severity

steps.description: Audit and adjust CSS media queries
steps.details: Update web/src/index.css and component styles with @media queries for tablet (<1024px) and mobile (<768px).

steps.description: Add ARIA labels and keyboard navigation handlers
steps.details: Ensure tabIndex, role, and aria-live announcements for alert stages are properly configured.
Define :focus-visible outlines with 2px solid #2563eb and 2px offset across all buttons, selects, and sliders.
Run Playwright test testing tab navigation and mobile viewport (375x667); capture screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-30-1.png.

technicalNotes: Test with 1366x768 default Playwright viewport as configured in lib/playwright.config.ts.
Do not use fast flickering animations to respect accessibility rules.
